label: ML Inference: ONNX Model
info: Runs the bearing-fault classifier that ships with this package (ONNX) on a vibration feature vector. Works as imported — it needs the optional onnxruntime-node runtime.

name: Runs as imported: bundled bearing-fault classifier (needs onnxruntime-node)
info:
The ml-inference node loads models/bearing_fault_clf.onnx, a small classifier bundled with this package (catalog entry 'bearing-fault-clf'). The function node cycles through five machine states and builds the feature vector the model expects: [rms, amp_1x, amp_2x, amp_3.5x, amp_0.5x] (order amplitudes of the vibration spectrum). The model returns one score per class — healthy, imbalance, misalignment, bearing, looseness — in msg.prediction; the second function picks the highest one.

ONNX needs the optional onnxruntime-node package (npm install onnxruntime-node in your Node-RED user directory if it was skipped).

Using your own model: upload it in the node's editor or copy it to <userDir>/ml-models and enter its file name as 'Model Path'. A model anywhere else is refused unless its directory is listed in settings.js under conditionMonitoring.allowedModelPaths. Set 'Input Shape' to what the model expects, e.g. [1,4].
